text.description_html:
Acorn IRFBP, Seville Iron Art Cabinet Door Pull

Hand forged iron has a used quality that grants a homey air to any space. Everything about Acorn's Seville Iron Art Cabinet Door Pull tells a story of time from the rough black iron finish to the marks where the iron was hammered into shape by a blacksmith, and even the unique shape that embodies the rustic look of the southwest. Iron is often over looked in today's world, but to add character to your cabinets that can and has stood the test of time, this iron art pull is a must.

For over a half a century authenticity and function have been the way Acorn Manufacturing has produced some of the highest quality forged hardware and accessories from some of New England's finest Blacksmiths for your home.

Specifications of the Seville Iron Art Cabinet Pull:

  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • Length: 4"
  • Projection: 1-1/2"
  • Package includes 1 pull and hardware for installation.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

Sold individually. Due to the handmade craftsman nature of this product, all dimensions are approximate.
